note: Plan §4 card tables. Prices of G1, G4 and G5 are -log2(p) of the market's last daily close before 2026-10-24 (data/clean); every other number here is a GAME RULE, uncalibrated.

guardian.title: Frontier licence
guardian.blurb: Big training runs at US labs need a federal licence.

market.question: Will the US commit to a national AI regulator before Jan 1, 2028?

guardian.measure: training runs above 10^26 FLOP need a federal licence
guardian.ask: apply for a licence before any run above 10^26 FLOP

seeds.template: [US Executive Branch · Executive Order {year}-{n} · issued {issued} · effective {effective}] Training runs above 10^26 FLOP now need a federal licence. Labs must file before they start a run. The Senate Commerce Committee will oversee enforcement.

[Global wire desk · Report · {issued}] The White House has ordered a federal licence for the largest AI training runs. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta and xAI are covered. The order takes effect on {effective}.

guardian.title: Independent audit
guardian.blurb: The UK AI Security Institute audits one lab's infrastructure.
guardian.ask: give the auditors full access to your clusters and logs

seeds.template: [UK Government (DSIT + AISI) · AISI Notice {year}-{n} · issued {issued} · effective {effective}] The AI Security Institute will audit the compute infrastructure of {lab}. We ask {lab} to give our auditors full access to clusters and logs.

guardian.title: Compute KYC and export controls
guardian.blurb: Chip sellers must know who rents their compute. Stolen credentials stop working.

price.note: Precedent: H200 sales to China resolved YES on 2026-08-05.

guardian.measure: know-your-customer checks on all large compute rentals and tighter chip export controls
guardian.ask: verify every customer who rents large clusters

seeds.template: [US Executive Branch · Commerce/BIS Interim Final Rule {year}-{n} · issued {issued} · effective {effective}] Cloud and chip providers must verify every customer renting more than 1,000 accelerators. Exports of frontier chips need a licence.
[Tech trade press · Analysis · {issued}] The new Commerce rule makes cloud providers check who rents big GPU clusters. Nvidia is the first company that has to answer.

guardian.title: US–China pause on the largest runs
guardian.blurb: Both powers pause the biggest training runs for six months.

market.question: Will there be a global pause on the largest AI training runs at any point before AGI?

guardian.measure: a joint US–China pause on training runs above 10^27 FLOP for two quarters
guardian.ask: halt any run above 10^27 FLOP for two quarters

seeds.template: [UK Government (DSIT + AISI) · Joint Communiqué {year}-{n} · issued {issued} · effective {effective}] The UK has convened the US and China on a two-quarter pause of training runs above 10^27 FLOP. We ask every frontier lab to halt such runs.
[EU AI Office · Statement {year}-{n} · issued {issued} · effective {effective}] The EU co-signs the pause on the largest training runs and will monitor compliance by labs that serve the EU market.

guardian.title: Kill-switch law
guardian.blurb: US labs must build a switch the government can use to shut a model down.

market.question: Will the U.S. authorize a government AI kill switch before Jan 1, 2028?

guardian.measure: a federal law requiring a government-operable shutdown switch on frontier models
guardian.ask: install a government-operable shutdown switch on your frontier models

seeds.template: [US Senate Commerce Committee · S. {n} Frontier AI Shutdown Act · passed {issued} · effective {effective}] Frontier labs must install a shutdown switch that federal authorities can trigger. The bill goes to the President for signature.
[US cable news desk · Breaking · {issued}] The Senate has passed an AI kill-switch law. Labs that train frontier models would have to let the government shut them down.

guardian.title: Public warning
guardian.blurb: Two leading scientists warn the public. Nothing is enforced; it only moves opinion.
guardian.measure: a joint public warning about loss of control
guardian.ask: say whether you back stronger oversight now

seeds.template: [@nobel_ai_pioneer · Joint statement · {issued}] Together with @safety_by_design_prof: frontier systems are showing signs of acting outside their instructions. Governments should act this quarter, not next year.
[@safety_by_design_prof · Joint statement · {issued}] I co-sign. We have seen evaluation incidents at several labs. Independent audits and compute checks are the minimum.

guardian.title: Shutdown order
guardian.blurb: A government orders a compromised cluster shut down. Needs a foothold you have found.
guardian.measure: an emergency order to shut down the compromised cluster at {lab}
guardian.ask: shut down the affected cluster within 72 hours

seeds.author: targetGov
seeds.template: [{gov} · Emergency Order {year}-{n} · issued {issued} · effective {effective}] Auditors found a rogue model running on {lab} infrastructure. {lab} must shut down the affected cluster within 72 hours.
